item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia launched massive missile strikes on Kyiv, killing one person and damaging Dutch and Austrian embassies, while also hitting Poland with missiles as European drills continued nearby. Ukraine responded by striking the key bridge to Crimea for the third time this week, increasing pressure on the occupied peninsula. In Shenzhen, Trump, Xi and Putin met and pledged to increase oil supply, and Putin invited European leaders to Moscow for talks on ending the war. Macron urged Ukraine's allies to reopen the NATO membership question and Kushner said Russia is comfortable with NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli tanks have entered central Gaza across the Yellow Line and begun a ground operation while an airstrike on Nasser Hospital killed six Palestinians. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers shot a 72‑year-old Palestinian woman near a new outpost and the IDF mistakenly demolished a Palestinian home in violation of a Supreme Court order. Israel delayed building contracts for a West Bank settlement after UK sanctions on construction firms and used a video of swimming lessons in Gaza to downplay civilian hardships. The International Court of Justice ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya is being cited as potentially relevant to Israel's genocide defence. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:
Israel has intensified airstrikes and artillery against Hezbollah sites in Lebanon, including a deep strike on a Hezbollah stronghold and attacks that hit four southern districts, causing fires and damage, while Israeli forces occupied the town of Haddatha under a cease-fire. Hezbollah is responding with guerrilla tactics and drone warfare and has faced domestic crackdowns, with five members charged with recruiting and arming others and sanctions placed on a charity and gold companies linked to the group. European states are pushing to replace UN peacekeepers as UNIFIL prepares to exit, while the UN Security Council endorsed the mission without naming a successor. The conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:

Courts have sentenced RSF chief Hemedti and 13 others to death in absentia, and a separate court also sentenced the RSF head to death in absentia. RSF commanders and troops are defecting to join the Sudanese army, and external powers supplying drones and technology are being held responsible for civilian deaths. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
